explanations.answer: Put the Lord your God to the test
explanations.explanation: Yes, friend. Jesus answers, "It also says, 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test'" (Luke 4:12). Notice the word "also." Jesus isn't throwing out the devil's verse, He's setting another one beside it. And He stays right where He is.

explanations.answer: Stand upon the pinnacle of the temple
